name: Scourgebane's re-roll chain stops at eight strikes when its chance is forced to 100%
contract: Scourgebane 92111: 'Direct damage dealt now has a $520007h% chance to strike an enemy with Scourgebane'. The strike 801832 is itself direct damage and re-rolls the chance, synchronously inside the previous strike. Pure Focus 707852 adds its effect 0 amount to the 520007 chance (20 + 10); the fixture sets that amount to 80, so the chance reads 100%. Without a bound the chain would recurse until the target died or the stack overflowed; the cap allows at most 8 strikes per chain, against a longest observed chain of 6 in the Ascension logs. Every landed main-hand swing therefore produces exactly 8 strikes, which also shows that the 7 re-rolls below the cap still happen.
